name: Sotonure ~Haruka no Roshutsu Ecchi Days~
original_name: そとぬれ～はるかの露出エッチDAYS～
source:
Main character is a college student with otaku hobbies. He is visited by a female cousin undergoing exposure training on the internet. Protagonist takes patronage over her with the aim to present her wearing a super exposing dress at the next cosplay event.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位有着御宅族爱好的大学生。一位正在接受互联网曝光培训的表妹拜访了他。主角赞助她，目的是让她在下一次的角色扮演活动中穿上超级暴露的衣服。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
